description: "Use when editing project documentation, GDD modules, engineering docs, ADRs, MVP scope, post-MVP scope, or open questions."
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---
# Documentation Rules

- Preserve the MVP / Post-MVP / Open Questions structure in design modules.
- Update the relevant design doc when implementation behavior changes.
- Add an ADR for architecture, tooling, platform SDK, monetization policy, or MVP scope decisions.
- Keep engineering docs concise and link to detailed design modules rather than duplicating them.
- Follow `docs/engineering/DOCUMENTATION.md`.
